name: Transamerica Pyramid
note: Its 260 m (OpenStreetMap, roof:shape=pyramidal) at four fifths: a body narrowing in three steps to 208 m and a spire above it, white like its quartz cladding.
source: OpenStreetMap way 24222973 'Transamerica Pyramid', height 260, building:levels 48, roof:shape pyramidal (blocks/labels.json)

name: Coit Tower
note: The fluted concrete column on Telegraph Hill at its full 64 m, with its arcaded gallery and cap.
source: OpenStreetMap way 28824850 'Coit Tower', man_made=tower, tower:type=observation, height 64

name: San Francisco Ferry Building
note: The long two-storey terminal on the Embarcadero with its clock tower rising to 75 m from the middle of the hall.
source: OpenStreetMap outline 'San Francisco Ferry Building' (split from its USA Structures footprint); the tower's 75 m from its published height, which OpenStreetMap does not carry

name: Palace of Fine Arts
note: The rotunda by its lagoon: eight piers carrying a stepped dome to 48 m over an open floor, in the ochre and rose of its plaster.

name: Alcatraz Main Prison
note: The island's cellhouse as a long three-storey hall of tiers; OpenStreetMap names it and gives it no height.
source: OpenStreetMap outline 'Main Prison' on Alcatraz Island (split from its USA Structures footprint)

name: Alcatraz Island Lighthouse
note: The 26 m lighthouse beside the cellhouse, as a square tower with a gallery and lantern; labelled a utility by its tags, which would have made it a ring of tanks.
source: OpenStreetMap way 99202294 'Alcatraz Island Lighthouse', man_made=lighthouse, height 26
